`catalog-v1.sqlite.gz` is an inert synthetic configuration archive from the
stock `database/backup.Export` at Product `0b8b5fcb04747615a594be36c11d4d6b04f920d8`,
with Zapret `v0.1.18` and the old setting-only catalog. Only Zapret was installed
in the fixture's temporary database. The archive has no runtime activation.
It contains one administrator strategy (`ui-zapret-legacy`, TCP port 443).
The old catalog revision is asserted by the restore test.
